lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized in approximately four discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a structured 2D grid arrangement with roughly uniform inter-centroid spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of high-intensity spots to form a lattice-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transitioning from high-luminance reflectance above to deep shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette of a commensal fish is visible swimming adjacent to the ventral-lateral region, posterior to the pectoral fin's trailing edge.
